probes.text: Steve, Robin, Jonathan, and Nancy work shifts at a small local radio station, slipping coded messages into their broadcasts.
The group has a nickname for their sneaking trips into the Upside Down: they call them "crawls."
Hawkins sits under military quarantine, with soldiers having set up a base camp inside the Upside Down itself.

probes.text: Dustin, Steve, Nancy, and Jonathan chase a Demogorgon away from the others and through a gate into the Upside Down.
Nancy and Jonathan climb up onto the roof of Hawkins Lab and find something strange sitting there.
Erica and Murray turn up at their old science teacher's door, hoping he can help pinpoint where Dustin's group is.
Dustin tries to walk a baffled Steve through his theory about what the Upside Down actually is.
At the hospital, Lucas and Robin keep watch over Max's bed, with Robin's girlfriend there too.
Erica, Murray, and Mr. Clarke hunch over overlaid maps, pinpointing where Dustin's group sits on the other side.
The group studies the radio station's tower, planning a climb, and readies a timer-rigged bomb to carry with them.
Will finds himself watching scenes from Henry's childhood past unfold around him.
The rest of the group makes its way up and across toward the Abyss.
